POST /v1/comms.summary: Send a memo, announcement, newsletter or job post
POST /v1/comms.description: The content is a sealed message already placed in a wall audience or forum by the device; this call registers it as a communication. It is published at once or held for approval, depending on the communication rule and approval flows (f1 announcements, f10 memos). The sender picks the message id (a UUID v7) and the key generation.
POST /v1/comms.access: a role with the matching right (Memos: Send memos; Announcements: Post; Newsletter: Publish newsletters; Job posts: Post job posts)

request.type: string, required. Memo | Announcement | Newsletter | Job post
request.conversation: uuid, required. The wall or forum it goes to
request.message: uuid, required. UUID v7 chosen by the sender; the content is bound to it
request.envelope: base64, required. The sealed content, up to about 600 KB
request.batch: uuid. Shared by the copies sent together to several places

comm.type: string. Memo | Announcement | Newsletter | Job post
comm.conversation: uuid. The wall or forum it is posted in
comm.message: uuid. The sealed message that carries the content
comm.read: integer. People who have read it

response.approval: object. The approval request when it was held (see GET /v1/approvals), otherwise null

errors.400: Unknown type, not a valid envelope, bad message id, or not a wall or forum
errors.409: epoch_changed: fetch the new key and send again

GET /v1/comms.description: Published ones in conversations I am in, plus mine; people with the See who read right see all.
GET /v1/comms.access: any signed-in member of the organization (token issued with `org`)

comms.type: string. Memo | Announcement | Newsletter | Job post
comms.conversation: uuid. The wall or forum it is posted in
comms.message: uuid. The sealed message that carries the content
comms.read: integer. People who have read it

GET /v1/comms/{id}/content.summary: The sealed content of one communication
GET /v1/comms/{id}/content.description: Returns the envelope for a client to open with the conversation key.
GET /v1/comms/{id}/content.access: any signed-in member of the organization (token issued with `org`)

POST /v1/comms/contents.summary: The sealed content of many communications at once
POST /v1/comms/contents.description: Same as the single content call for up to 200 ids; ones the caller may not see are left out.
POST /v1/comms/contents.access: any signed-in member of the organization (token issued with `org`)

POST /v1/comms/{id}/read.access: any signed-in member of the organization (token issued with `org`)

GET /v1/comms/{id}/insights.description: For every place it was posted: audience, reads, reactions and replies (contents stay sealed). `totals` measures the whole communication across all its places, one person counted once: someone in two places, or who met it on the wall and again in a forum, is reached, read and acknowledged once; their first read counts for speed.
GET /v1/comms/{id}/insights.access: a role with View insights on that type's page

places.read_in_48h: integer. Read within 48 hours of going out
places.median_read_mins: integer. Half of the readers had read it by this many minutes (absent until someone reads it)

GET /v1/comms/rules.description: Who may send memos and announcements to which audiences at each level, and who approves them. Keyed by level (departments, branches, sectors, units) then type (Memo, Announcement).
GET /v1/comms/rules.access: any signed-in member of the organization (token issued with `org`)

to: string. Audiences it may be sent to

PUT /v1/comms/rules/{level}/{type}.description: `level` is departments, branches, sectors or units; `type` is Memo or Announcement.
PUT /v1/comms/rules/{level}/{type}.access: a role with Roles: Configure approvals

to: string. Audiences it may be sent to

errors.400: Unknown level or type, or more than 8 audiences

GET /v1/awards.description: The awards approved in the current weekly cycle, which runs from Saturday 00:00 to the next Saturday 00:00 in the organization's time zone, plus the cycle's dates.

awards.in_cycle: boolean. true when approved in the current weekly cycle
targets: string. Places it may be announced

POST /v1/awards.description: Up to 20 people and 20 places to announce it. It becomes visible once approved (flow f7).

people: uuid, required. Up to 20 active people
targets: string. Up to 20 places to announce it

award.in_cycle: boolean. true when approved in the current weekly cycle
targets: string. Places it may be announced

response.approval: object. The approval request when one is needed

errors.400: Missing fields, too many people or places, or someone nominated is not an active member

POST /v1/awards/{id}/claim.summary: Mark one place of an award as announced
POST /v1/awards/{id}/claim.description: Succeeds for the first call per place and answers 409 afterwards, so an award is announced once.
POST /v1/awards/{id}/claim.access: the nominator, after the award is approved

errors.409: not_approved: not approved yet; already_posted: that place is already announced

GET /v1/comms/{id}/places.summary: Where a communication may be reposted
GET /v1/comms/{id}/places.access: anyone who can see the communication

POST /v1/comms/{id}/remind.summary: Remind only the people who have not read it
POST /v1/comms/{id}/remind.description: Sends a notification to everyone the communication reached who has not read it yet, in every place it went. At most once every 6 hours per communication (429 otherwise).
POST /v1/comms/{id}/remind.access: a role with View insights on that type's page

POST /v1/comms/seen.summary: Record communications really seen on screen
POST /v1/comms/seen.description: The browser reports memos, announcements, newsletters and job posts on the wall or in a forum that were at least 60% visible for 2 seconds. Each counts as read once; the author and people outside that place are never counted.
POST /v1/comms/seen.access: any signed-in member of the organization (token issued with `org`)

GET /v1/comms/engagement.summary: How the latest communications landed, in one request
GET /v1/comms/engagement.description: Up to 300 published communications of the types the caller may see insights for, newest first. Reached = current members of the place it went to, except the author; reads, acknowledgements and timing count only that audience.
GET /v1/comms/engagement.access: a role with View insights on that type's page (403 when the caller has it for no type)

comms.batch: uuid. Copies sent together share it
